const d = $('Parse Blueprint').first().json;
return [{ json: { success: false, halted: true, reason: d.error_message, raw_response: d.raw_response || null } }];

const d = $('Capture Blueprint Decision').first().json;
return [{ json: { success: false, halted: true, reason: 'Blueprint rejected', approval_notes: d.approval_notes || '' } }];

const d = $('Capture Post-Fix Decision').first().json;
return [{ json: { success: false, halted: true, reason: 'Post-fix review rejected', approval_notes: d.post_fix_approval_notes || '' } }];
